catalog.characteristicsHelp: The model comes from National Catalog. * means required for moderation. Drafts may be incomplete.
catalog.enterTnvedFirst: Enter the TN VED code first in the basic information.
catalog.confirmTnved: Finish entering TN VED and click Find categories or press Enter. No Catalog requests are sent while typing.
catalog.loadingCategories: Matching categories to the product group and TN VED…
catalog.noMatchingCategories: Catalog returned no active categories for this group and TN VED. Check the code.
catalog.categoriesMatchTnved: Categories come from Catalog. Catalog checks the selected category when the request is sent.
catalog.permitInvalid: Enter the document number and a valid registration date. Catalog receives number:::YYYY-MM-DD.
catalog.unsupportedDictionary: National Catalog references an unsupported dictionary. Closed values cannot be replaced with free text.
catalog.publicationNotice: Saving in CertFlow keeps the data in this application. Creating or updating a Catalog draft does not start moderation. Complete the attributes, save changes to Catalog, then submit for moderation and sign with your certificate.
catalog.retryNotice: Do not create another card if the response was lost. Retrying with the same key returns the saved submission without resending to Catalog.
catalog.invalid: Check the attribute value, type and unit.
catalog.noCategories: Catalog returned no active categories for the selected product group.
catalog.emptyHistory: No cards have been sent from this app. This is not the complete list in your Catalog account.
catalog.feedResultHelp: These remarks concern the indicated feed ID. The current card state and signing results are shown separately.
catalog.unknownNotice: The feed ID is not confirmed. Check the card in National Catalog. Automatic resubmission is blocked.
catalog.moderatedNotice: Feed validation finished. Check product errors and the current card state above: processing a draft feed does not mean the card has passed moderation.
catalog.signedNotice: National Catalog reports approved cards as signed. This is a feed status; check the final card status in the account.
catalog.correctRejection: Correct the indicated data in the form above and submit the card again. These reasons are saved on the server and remain available when you reopen the card.

diagnostics.title: Support details
diagnostics.failed: Could not copy. Select and copy the ID.

catalog.acceptedNotice: Catalog accepted the feed for processing. Refresh the result: draft creation, moderation and publication are separate stages.
catalog.rejectedNotice: National Catalog rejected the feed. Correct the data and submit a new request. Replaying the old request does not send another feed.
catalog.modelHint: Categories, units and dictionary values come from the Catalog model. The Catalog API decides whether to accept the card.
catalog.enterBaseGtinForPackaging: Enter the primary GTIN to add other packaging levels.
catalog.gtinRecoveryStorageBlocked: This browser could not save the generation recovery key. Generation is blocked; check storage settings and reload. Previously generated codes can be read separately.
catalog.industrialGroupInvalid: Industrial cards are available only for industrial product groups supported by Catalog.
catalog.industrialInitialInvalid: Create a single industrial product first for this group. Add inner packaging after its GTIN is confirmed.
catalog.fullTnvedInvalid: Full TN VED must contain 10 digits and start with the entered four-digit code.

permits.title: Permits
permits.description: Look up National Catalog permit information by document number and date, or by a published card’s GTIN. The card owner’s INN is optional. This does not issue or register documents in FGIS.
permits.innOptional: Optional. Enter an INN to specify the card owner.
permits.failed: Could not retrieve National Catalog information
permits.empty: The National Catalog returned an empty result. The document status is unconfirmed.
permits.pending: The National Catalog requested government registry information. Check again later; this response does not confirm absence or invalidity.

aggregation.reconcileId: Document ID from the Honest Sign account
aggregation.title: SSCC aggregation
aggregation.intro: Box → pallet → Honest Sign confirmation. Non-tobacco transport units are supported.
aggregation.prerequisites: Complete and confirm printing, then synchronize offline jobs. Register boxes before the pallet. Printing an SSCC does not register the unit in Honest Sign.
aggregation.noGroups: No supported product group is available. Check the participant registration in Honest Sign.
aggregation.review: 2. Compare the composition with the document and physical unit. The draft expires in 30 minutes. The signature covers this exact checked composition.
aggregation.physical: I have checked the physical contents against the document. The attached label scans correctly; dimensions, quiet zones and print quality have been verified.
aggregation.rights: I confirm the participant's rights to the GS1/GLN prefix and prevention of SSCC duplicates in other systems.
aggregation.sign: 3. Sign with QES and send to Honest Sign
aggregation.certificate: Select a valid participant QES certificate.
aggregation.confirmFirst: Select a certificate and confirm the composition and GS1 prefix rights.
aggregation.afterSubmit: Submission does not mean registration. Refresh the journal status: only Accepted / CHECKED_OK confirms completion. Document composition is protected after submission.
aggregation.afterError: Refresh the journal before continuing. A connection error does not prove that Honest Sign did not receive the document.
aggregation.unknown: Delivery outcome is unknown. Retry is blocked. Find the document in your Honest Sign account and enter its ID in the journal. The sender and full composition will be verified; success cannot be assigned manually.

honestSign.title: Honest Sign
honestSign.description: Marking-code orders and documents over a protected connection.

dmCheck.title: Check DM
dmCheck.description: Upload code files to check their authenticity and current statuses in Chestny ZNAK.
dmCheck.fileHint: UTF-8 TXT or CSV · one full code per line · up to 30,000 codes
dmCheck.emptyHelp: You can select several files. Authenticity checks require full marking codes from the export.
dmCheck.duplicates: Duplicate rows: {{count}}. Identical codes are checked once.
dmCheck.cancelled: The check was stopped. Run it again to obtain a complete result.
dmCheck.noInformation: Chestny ZNAK returned no matching information for this code.

errors.invalidFile: Use a UTF-8 TXT or CSV file with one full marking code on each line.
errors.emptyFile: One of the selected files contains no codes.
errors.tooManyCodes: You can check up to 30,000 unique codes at a time.
errors.tooManyFiles: You can add up to 20 files to one check.
errors.fileTooLarge: The total size of selected files must not exceed 20 MB.

certificateLogin.title: Connect to Honest Sign
certificateLogin.description: Choose a certificate from the local CryptoPro store. The private key never leaves this computer.
certificateLogin.empty: CryptoPro returned no available certificates. Check the plugin installation and make sure a valid certificate is present.

workspace.requiredHint: Fields with a coloured bar are required
workspace.quantityError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 2,000,000.
workspace.productsLimit: An order can contain no more than 10 product lines.
workspace.completedOrdersHint: Closed orders and orders processed with an OMS error.
workspace.getCodesDescription: Retrieve codes from the order, download the file and prepare them for the converter.
workspace.codesPreparedResult: Codes received: {{count}}. They are saved for submission to the converter.

workspace.ordersEmpty: No orders match the selected filters.

workspace.orderDetailsEmpty: Honest Sign returned no details for this order.

source.label: Code source
source.fromDocument: CertFlow document — all printed DataMatrix codes
source.hint: The report includes every DataMatrix code with the Printed status, without manual removal. Documents belong to the current company, including archived documents. Documents with no printed codes or more than 30,000 codes cannot be selected. Offline printing must be synced to the server first.
source.empty: No documents found. Change your search or use CSV / manual input for legacy documents.
source.loaded: Selected {{count}} DataMatrix codes with the Printed status. Check the codes before signing and sending. If the selection changes, refresh and check it again.
source.previewLimit: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} codes. Every selected code will be checked and submitted.
source.loadFailed: Could not load report source documents.
source.codesLoadFailed: Could not load the document's printed DataMatrix codes.

documents.datesHint: The product card must be Ready for circulation. The production date cannot be in the future. For dairy goods, select the marking-code type and expiration mode that match the product card and the package marking.
documents.productionDateHint: Leave this empty when it is not required for the selected product group and package type.
documents.partNumberHint: Trade-item dairy only. Latin letters, digits, and / . , - are allowed.
documents.cisTypeHint: The type must match the marking-code type in the order.
documents.expirationMilkHint: SUZ API 3.0.40 requires production and expiration dates for dairy trade items. Dates are sent as YYYY-MM-DD.
documents.requiredDatesHint: Trade items require production and expiration dates. The signed JSON uses YYYY-MM-DD dates.
documents.autofluidsDatesHint: Motor-oil trade items require both dates; expiration must be later than today. Group packages and sets may omit dates.
documents.expirationNotSpecifiedWarning: Use this mode only when the GTIN product card permits an omitted expiration date. If the product-use characteristic is ‘Shelf life’, GIS MT rejects every marking code with error 31 (EXDA/EXCN).
documents.expirationSetHint: Dairy group packages and sets do not send dates or a batch number in the report.
documents.expirationConditionsHint: Use the positive numeric storage-condition index from the product card. Each index may be entered once.
documents.codePlaceholder: Scan or paste a marking code
documents.bufferEmpty: Add codes manually or upload a CSV file.
documents.readyToSubmit: All codes are valid. The report is ready to sign and submit.
documents.checkRequired: Validate the current code buffer before submitting.

errors.commonFields: Check the product group, dates, and batch number.
errors.csvOnly: Only CSV files can be uploaded.
errors.csvEmpty: No codes were found in the CSV file.
errors.tooManyCodes: One True API validation request can contain at most 1,000 codes.
errors.tooManyReportCodes: A report must contain between 1 and 30,000 codes.
errors.duplicateCodes: A report cannot contain duplicate codes.
errors.csvRead: Could not read the CSV file.
errors.invalidCodes: Fix or remove codes that failed validation.
errors.checkBeforeSubmit: Validate the current code buffer before submitting.
errors.certificate: The current session certificate is unavailable. Sign in again.
errors.reportId: OMS accepted the request but returned no report ID, so submission cannot be confirmed.

batch.explanation: Each file creates a separate report with its own expiry settings. All signed reports are saved on the server first, then submitted to SUZ in order.
batch.pauseHint: The queue is submitted sequentially while this screen remains open. Closing the app leaves unsent reports on the server; continue from the reports list.
batch.fileHint: TXT or CSV, one complete marking code per line. Up to 20 files, 30,000 codes per file and 100,000 codes in total. Enter separate dates for each file.
batch.empty: Upload files with different expiry dates
batch.duplicates: Duplicate codes found within or across files: {{count}}. Correct the files before submitting.
batch.checkProgressDetailed: File {{current}} of {{total}}: {{name}} · Codes: {{completed}} of {{codes}} · Total checked: {{totalCompleted}} of {{totalCodes}}
batch.checkStopped: Checking stopped. Results for completed files are retained; remaining files can be checked separately.
batch.checkIncomplete: Checking this file did not finish. Retry checking the remaining files.
batch.confirm: I have checked the product group, codes and expiry settings for every file. I confirm signing all reports with my certificate and submitting them in order.
batch.storing: Saving the signed queue on the server…
batch.storeRetryHint: Retry saving: an already saved batch will reopen without creating a duplicate. After restarting, check the queue in the reports list.
batch.serverSaved: The data is saved on the server. “Submitted to SUZ” means a report ID was received; SUZ processing results are shown separately.
batch.blockedHint: The queue stopped after a rejected or unknown submission. Check its receipt; you can explicitly skip the affected file without resubmitting it, then continue the remaining files.
batch.sendingHint: The server is submitting a report. Refresh the state to obtain its receipt. Do not create a new queue with the same codes.
batch.historyHint: Server queues remain available after restarting the application.
batch.historyEmpty: There are no saved queues yet.

errors.store: Could not confirm that the queue was saved.
errors.process: Could not continue submitting. Refresh the queue state.
errors.fileLimit: A queue can contain up to 20 files.
errors.fileName: The file name must be no longer than 200 characters and contain no paths or control characters.
errors.fileSize: Each file must be no larger than 12 MiB.
errors.codeLimit: A queue can contain up to 100,000 codes.
errors.batchSize: The signed data exceeds the 20 MiB queue limit. Split the files into separate queues.
errors.fields: Check each file's dates and codes. Duplicate codes cannot be submitted.
errors.invalidCodes: Some codes failed the checks. Correct the files; detailed statuses are available in the “Check DM” tab.
errors.checkFile: Could not check file “{{name}}”. {{reason}} Results for completed files are retained.
errors.checkFirst: Complete the dates, check the codes and confirm signing.
errors.productionDate: Enter a valid production date no later than today.
errors.expirationDate: Enter a valid expiry date no earlier than production. For motor oils, it must be later than today.
errors.skip: Could not skip the file. Refresh the queue state.

batch.skipUnknownDescription: The original submission outcome is unknown: SUZ may have accepted the report. This file will be excluded from the queue without resubmitting it, and its uncertainty and diagnostics will be retained. Other files will remain queued until you explicitly select “Continue submitting”.
batch.skipRejectedDescription: This report will not be submitted again. Its rejection and diagnostics will be retained, and the file will be excluded from the queue. Submit other signed files by selecting “Continue submitting” separately.

documentsCenter.reportsDescription: Sign and submit the full list of applied marking codes to OMS.
documentsCenter.processingNote: A report ID confirms only that OMS accepted the request. The “Sent” status is not proof of successful processing; check processed documents and the Honest Sign receipt for the final result.
documentsCenter.emptyReports: No reports have been submitted in this session. Drafts generated automatically when codes are retrieved remain available in the Honest Sign account.
